ACCOUNT = '000000000000'
NS = 'StackdSearch/Project2-trial333/' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]

    if key.startswith('AWS_ENDPOINT_URL'):
        del ENV[key]
ANCHOR = int(time.time() // 300) * 300 - 600
stamp = lambda sec: datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(sec, datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat().replace('+00:00', 'Z')
cap = {'region': REGION, 'caller_account': ACCOUNT, 'namespace': NS, 'anchor_seconds': ANCHOR, 'sources': [{'path': __file__, 'content': Path(__file__).read_text()}, {'path': 'scripts/aws/aws_cli.py', 'content': Path('scripts/aws/aws_cli.py').read_text()}], 'primary_references': ['https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/search-expression-syntax.html', 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/search-expression-examples.html', 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/using-metric-math.html', 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/APIReference/API_GetMetricData.html'], 'observations': [], 'cleanup': {'deletable_resources_created': [], 'continuing_publishers': False, 'explanation': 'Custom metric samples have no deletion API and remain subject to normal CloudWatch retention.'}}

    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(cap, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')

    proc = run(service, operation, parameters, ENV, options=['--debug', '--no-paginate', '--cli-connect-timeout', '5', '--cli-read-timeout', '30'], timeout=45)
    res = result(proc, debug=True)
    for line in proc.stderr.splitlines():
        if 'Response headers:' in line:
            try:
                headers = ast.literal_eval(line.split('Response headers:', 1)[1].strip())
                for key, value in headers.items():
                    if key.lower() in ('x-amzn-requestid', 'x-amzn-request-id', 'x-amz-request-id'):
                        res['request_id'] = value
            except (ValueError, SyntaxError):
                pass
        if line.startswith(("b'{", 'b"{')):
            try:
                res['output'] = json.loads(ast.literal_eval(line))
            except (ValueError, SyntaxError):
                pass
    if service == 'sts' and res['code'] == 'Success':
        cap['actor_arn'] = res['output']['Arn']
    cap['observations'].append({'label': label, 'service': service, 'operation': operation, 'input': parameters, 'region': REGION, 'caller_account': ACCOUNT, 'actor_arn': cap.get('actor_arn', ''), 'request_started_ms': started, 'result': res})

    print(label, res['code'], [(r['Id'], r.get('Label'), r.get('Values')) for r in res.get('output', {}).get('MetricDataResults', [])], flush=True)
    return res

        queries = [{'Id': 'e' + str(i + 1), 'Expression': expr} for i, expr in enumerate(expressions)]
    return request(label, 'get-metric-data', {'StartTime': stamp(ANCHOR), 'EndTime': stamp(ANCHOR + 300), 'ScanBy': 'TimestampAscending', 'MetricDataQueries': queries, **fields})

    body = (schema if schema is not None else '{"' + NS + '"}') + (' ' + term if term else '')
    return "SEARCH('" + body + "', '" + stat + "'" + (', ' + str(period) if period is not None else '') + ')'

        ('implicit-and', 'MetricName="CustomCount1" Node=red'), ('explicit-and', 'MetricName="CustomCount1" AND Node=red'),
        ('explicit-or', 'MetricName="SDBFailure" OR MetricName="NetworkErrors2"'),

    query('namespace-designator-wrong-case', [search('Namespace="'+NS.lower()+'"', schema='')])

    query('exact-unescaped-special-name', [search('MetricName="Europe\\\\France Traffic(Network)\\"Quote"')])

measured_behavior.observed: All 12 direct metrics and all 12 schema-free SEARCH results contain the published values. Initial schema-only poll was corrected using a positive no-schema Namespace designator control, not treated as evidence of absent metrics.

Schema requires exact dimension-name set: namespace-only selects the dimensionless identity; ServiceName selects 2 exact-one-dimension identities; ServiceName,Node selects 5 exact-two-dimension identities and excludes the extra Extra dimension; all 3 dimensions select that identity. Dimension order reversal succeeds. Missing/wrong-case names select none.

count/Count/COUNT match the same 7 name/key/value identities; couNT matches none. Targeted MetricName=customcount and CUSTOMCOUNT match both CustomCount1 and customcount1; count1 matches CustomCount1; customc and ount match none. Numeric 333 matches all 12 through namespace, 33 matches none. These native lowercase-composite results differ from the documented negative examples.

Quoted MetricName/Namespace exact matches and dimension key names are case-sensitive; unqualified quoted CustomCount1 also matches dimension key/value. network/errors matches both Network-Errors_2 and NetworkErrors2; exact punctuation mismatch selects none.

Implicit and explicit AND agree; AND binds tighter than OR in the distinguishing pair; grouping changes selection. NOT exclusion and standalone NOT work. Lowercase and is admitted as a term but selects none.

Exact backslash, escaped double-quote, and escaped apostrophe cases select published identities. Both escaped and unescaped parentheses within the quoted metric name succeed. A comma after the schema before a term is rejected.

Period omitted from both SEARCH and query fails. Query Period supplies omitted SEARCH period; explicit SEARCH period wins conflicting query Period. 300 seconds aggregates both sparse samples per identity. 1,5,30,60.5 admitted for these standard-resolution samples; 61 fails multiple-of-60 validation. Zero, negative and string periods fail with distinct exact errors.

Weighted values preserve average versus sum distinction; SampleCount is 4 per published datum. Percentile and trimmed statistics admitted with returned approximate values. Lowercase sum and Bogus rejected.

Every expanded member retains the expression Id. Within the broad SEARCH results, default labels are lexically ordered; equal labels retain observed distinct-value order without inferred tie-break. Explicit nonempty labels prefix default labels; empty labels do not. Dynamic LABEL and PROP metric/namespace/dimension resolve discovered identity; missing dimension properties become --. Direct results precede SEARCH regardless opposing IDs or input order.

SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX/DATAPOINT_COUNT and array arithmetic consume SEARCH. Hidden source results are omitted. SUM values are 3264,1560,1824; AVG values 272,130,152 retain denominator 12 at sparse timestamps. Empty selection SUM yields one empty Complete result.

Low MaxDatapoints yields PartialData and exact Paginated-derived message on SEARCH arrays, with no NextToken. A one-series SEARCH with 2 actual points in 5 minutes is still partial at MaxDatapoints=2. Direct-only MaxDatapoints=1 traverses five minute-slot pages, including empty pages, with valid NextToken until exhaustion. Adding SEARCH suppresses the top-level token in the mixed control. Boundaries 48/59/60 preserve exact per-series partial/complete outcomes.

Current numeric/double-quoted account and LOCAL bare/double-quoted select owned metrics. Foreign account selects none. Unescaped inner single quotes are invalid outer expression syntax; escaped single quotes admitted but select none. Numeric and double-quoted-LOCAL OR lists work. No account links were changed.
SEARCH empty string is admitted; in this pre-existing account it selected 500 metrics and emitted exact MaxMetricsExceeded top-level message. Unowned result details are omitted explicitly.

inferences: Observed SEARCH schema selection uses exact dimension sets, unlike a naive dimension-subset interpretation of the documentation.
Sparse-pagination controls support allocation by requested time slots rather than only returned nonempty samples; precise general allocation across arbitrary query combinations is not inferred.
Native token controls establish the measured cases, not a complete reverse-engineered tokenization algorithm; documentation alone does not predict the observed lowercase composites.
unresolved_boundaries: No linked foreign-account metric was available; foreign selector emptiness does not establish successful cross-account retrieval or link-authority semantics.
Exact ordering of identical default labels and multi-expression math result ordering are preserved but not claimed to be stable service guarantees.
No hundreds-of-owned-metrics quota publication, retention aging or historical rollup experiment was performed.
Fractional-period admission was measured only at 60.5; no universal rounding rule is inferred.
Discovery readiness is bounded native evidence, not a persistence or latency guarantee.
